title: U.S. EPA Enforcement and Compliance History Online (ECHO) - Safe Drinking Water Act

operations.description: Based on the QID obtained from a get_systems query, return a comma separated value (CSV) file of the water systems found.
operations.summary: Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) Download Data Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] sdw rest services download [PARAMS] output qcolumns qid [SCHEMA]

operations.description: GET_QID is passed with a query ID corresponding to a previously run get_systems query. It then returns a Systems object containing all matching water systems. The main purpose of GET_QID is for large querysets that contain multiple pages (responsesets) of output. GET_QID allows for pagination and for the selection and sorting of columns.
operations.summary: Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) Paginated Results Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] sdw rest services qid [PARAMS] callback descending newsort output pageno qcolumns qid [SCHEMA] 2 3 results sdw systems water

operations.description: Returns an array of public water systems that meet the specified search criteria.
